gangs_by_prefix.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "GangCode" FROM "HR_GANGLN" WHERE "GangCode" LIKE ? ORDER BY "GangCode"
gangs_by_prefix.description: List gang codes filtered by code prefix

gangs_with_desc_by_prefix.sql: SELECT g."GangCode", g."Description" FROM "HR_GANG" g WHERE g."GangCode" LIKE ? ORDER BY g."GangCode"
gangs_with_desc_by_prefix.description: List gang code and description filtered by code prefix from HR_GANG

gangs_all_with_desc.sql: SELECT TOP (1000) g."GangCode", g."Description" FROM "HR_GANG" g WHERE g."GangCode" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g."GangCode"
gangs_all_with_desc.description: List all gang codes with descriptions from HR_GANG table

gangs_by_loc_code.sql: SELECT g."GangCode", g."Description" FROM "HR_GANG" g WHERE UPPER(g."LocCode") = UPPER(?) ORDER BY g."GangCode"
gangs_by_loc_code.description: List gang codes by exact LocCode from HR_GANG
